caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest on four legs, with the lid open. The chest has a rectangular body with slightly tapered sides, showing a natural wood grain texture and a mix of brown and yellowish tones throughout the surfaces. The edges of the chest and the lid are accentuated with darker outlines, and the lid is attached along the back edge, allowing it to stand open vertically. The four legs have a curved, cabriole shape, each with a matching wood grain pattern and color. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, providing no additional objects or context to the composition.
title: Dough Trough
